description:
On the Twin Cast podcast, we sit down with Mia Hibbert, owner of the Atlanta Wild, to talk about resilience, adaptability, and why perfection should never be the goal.

This conversation explores the mindset required to keep moving forward when things don't go as planned. Whether in sports, business, real estate, or life, mistakes are inevitable. What matters is how we respond, learn, and continue improving along the way.

We also discuss the importance of teaching the next generation that failure isn't the end of the story. Every setback carries a lesson, and every challenge creates an opportunity to grow stronger.

One of the biggest takeaways from this clip is that success isn't built on perfection—it's built on the willingness to keep getting better.

Fall forward. Learn the lesson. Keep going.

Follow for more Twin Cast conversations, leadership lessons, and real-world discussions.
